picture.alt: A bright school canteen with big windows, green trees outside and other students eating at tables in the back. Three young people sit side by side at a wooden table, each with a bowl of food on a blue tray. In the middle, a young man with wavy brown hair, a dark red shirt and a mustard-yellow sweater vest rests his cheek on one hand and looks down at a phone in the other hand; his eyebrows are raised and his mouth turns down, so he looks sad and worried. The dark blue bowl of noodles in front of him is untouched. On the left, a girl with short wavy dark hair, round glasses, a white collared shirt, a dark purple sweater vest and olive trousers puts one hand on his shoulder and holds the other hand out, smiling and talking to him. On the right, a girl with long wavy black hair, gold hoop earrings, a blue jacket over an orange top and white trousers smiles at him and holds out an open hand. Chopsticks lie on the left tray.

choices.english: Something on his phone is funny, and everyone is laughing.

choices.simplified: 他吃不完面，朋友要帮他吃。
choices.pinyin: Tā chī bù wán miàn, péngyǒu yào bāng tā chī.
choices.english: He can't finish his noodles, and his friends want to eat them for him.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他心情不好，朋友很關心他，陪他說話。
choices.simplified: 他心情不好，朋友很关心他，陪他说话。
choices.pinyin: Tā xīnqíng bù hǎo, péngyǒu hěn guānxīn tā, péi tā shuōhuà.
choices.english: He's feeling down; his friends are worried about him and keep him company, talking to him.

questions.why: His mouth turns down and his noodles are untouched: he is upset, and the two girls lean toward him, smiling and talking to him: they care about him (關心). The girls are smiling at him, not laughing at his phone, and he has not eaten any of his noodles.

picture.alt: Daytime outside an old house with a grey tiled roof and stone walls, under a blue sky with a few clouds. In the red wooden doorway stand an old man with grey hair in a bun, a white beard and a dark brown robe, one hand on the door frame, and an old woman with grey hair in a bun and a red robe, her hands pressed together in front of her chest; both are laughing and looking toward the monster. A red lantern hangs from the roof. Red firecrackers with gold bands lie on the stone steps and the ground and are going off with bright yellow sparks; bits of red paper fly through the air. On the right, a big furry teal-and-cream monster with one golden horn, a red-orange mane, wide frightened eyes and an open mouth full of fangs leaps away from the house with its paws in the air. Snow lies on the roofs in the background.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 發生了什麼事？
prompt.simplified: 发生了什么事？

prompt.english: What has happened?

choices.speaker: N

choices.simplified: 老太太跟先生让怪兽给吓到了。

choices.english: The monster wants to take away the firecrackers by the door.

questions.why: Firecrackers go off on the steps and the monster leaps away with frightened eyes: it has been scared off (讓鞭炮給嚇走了). lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 奶奶說除夕下午要拜祖先，是幾點開始？我一下子想不起來。
lines.simplified: 奶奶说除夕下午要拜祖先，是几点开始？我一下子想不起来。
lines.pinyin: Nǎinai shuō chúxī xiàwǔ yào bài zǔxiān, shì jǐ diǎn kāishǐ? Wǒ yíxiàzi xiǎng bù qǐlái.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 她昨天說過……我想起來了，是四點。不過她要我們早一個小時到。
lines.simplified: 她昨天说过……我想起来了，是四点。不过她要我们早一个小时到。
lines.pinyin: Tā zuótiān shuō guo……wǒ xiǎng qǐlái le, shì sì diǎn. Bùguò tā yào wǒmen zǎo yí ge xiǎoshí dào.
lines.english: She told us yesterday... Now I remember: four. But she wants us there an hour early.

lines.english: She can't cook all the chicken and duck for the offering by herself, so she wants us to help.

prompt.speaker: N

prompt.simplified: 他们最晚几点要到奶奶家？

lines.traditional: 社團要放在門口的新年海報，你完成了嗎？
lines.simplified: 社团要放在门口的新年海报，你完成了吗？

lines.traditional: 字都寫好了。那天大家還有什麼要求？我想不起來了。
lines.simplified: 字都写好了。那天大家还有什么要求？我想不起来了。

lines.english: I've finished the lettering. What else did everyone ask us to change that day? I can't remember.

lines.speaker: M

lines.pinyin: Duì, wǒ xiǎng qǐlái le, wǒ xiànzài jiù xiūgǎi.
lines.english: Right, I remember now. I’ll make the change now.

lines.speaker: F

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 在哪裡吃我都無所謂。可是媽媽每年都要煮水餃、炒米粉，還要煎年糕，從早上忙到晚上。
lines.simplified: 在哪里吃我都无所谓。可是妈妈每年都要煮水饺、炒米粉，还要煎年糕，从早上忙到晚上。

lines.speaker: F

lines.english: You're right. Let her have a good rest this year. I'll book a table.

prompt.speaker: N

prompt.simplified: 男的觉得什么比较重要？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de juéde shénme bǐjiào zhòngyào?

choices.english: New Year's Eve dinner should be at home.

choices.english: Mom shouldn't have to work so hard.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我們宿舍門口也貼一張春聯吧！妳喜歡「大吉大利」，還是「年年有餘」？

lines.pinyin: Hǎo, nà júzi jiāo gěi nǐ.
lines.english: Okay, the tangerines are yours to do.

prompt.speaker: N

lines.simplified: 他们都说没关系。我只担心我爷爷，他从来不用手机，我以为今年没办法跟他拜年了。
lines.pinyin: Tāmen dōu shuō méiguānxi. Wǒ zhǐ dānxīn wǒ yéye, tā cónglái bú yòng shǒujī, wǒ yǐwéi jīnnián méi bànfǎ gēn tā bàinián le.
lines.english: They all said it was fine. I only worried about my grandpa: he never uses a phone, and I thought I couldn't wish him a happy New Year this time.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那後來呢？
lines.simplified: 那后来呢？
lines.pinyin: Nà hòulái ne?
lines.english: So what happened?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我妹妹花了一個下午教他用手機。過年那天，他在手機上看到我，還叫我在外面要平平安安的。
lines.simplified: 我妹妹花了一个下午教他用手机。过年那天，他在手机上看到我，还叫我在外面要平平安安的。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei huā le yí ge xiàwǔ jiāo tā yòng shǒujī. Guònián nà tiān, tā zài shǒujī shàng kàndào wǒ, hái jiào wǒ zài wàimiàn yào píngpíng ān'ān de.
lines.english: My sister spent an afternoon teaching him to use a phone. At New Year he saw me on the phone and told me to stay safe while away from home.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你妹妹真厲害！
lines.simplified: 你妹妹真厉害！
lines.pinyin: Nǐ mèimei zhēn lìhài!
lines.english: Your sister is amazing!

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 是啊，要不是她，我今年就看不到爺爺了。
lines.simplified: 是啊，要不是她，我今年就看不到爷爷了。
lines.pinyin: Shì a, yàobúshì tā, wǒ jīnnián jiù kàn bú dào yéye le.
lines.english: Yes. If it weren't for her, I wouldn't have seen Grandpa at all this year.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的本來為什麼擔心？
prompt.simplified: 男的本来为什么担心？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de běnlái wèishénme dānxīn?
prompt.english: Why was the man worried at first?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Jiārén huì bù gāoxìng.
choices.english: His family would be unhappy.

choices.speaker: N

choices.english: His sister can't use a phone.

choices.english: He'd have to eat New Year's Eve dinner alone.

questions.why: 從來不用手機: Grandpa had never used a phone, so he thought he could not greet him. His family, the woman’s guess, had said it was fine, and it is his sister who taught Grandpa.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的說「要不是她」，是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 男的说「要不是她」，是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de shuō “yàobúshì tā”, shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the man mean by 'if it weren't for her'?

choices.speaker: N

choices.english: It wasn't his sister who taught Grandpa.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā jīnnián méi jiàndào yéye.
choices.english: He didn't get to see Grandpa this year.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Mèimei yě xiǎng gēn yéye bàinián.
choices.english: His sister also wanted to wish Grandpa a happy New Year.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 因為妹妹，他才見到爺爺
choices.simplified: 因为妹妹，他才见到爷爷
choices.pinyin: Yīnwèi mèimei, tā cái jiàndào yéye.
choices.english: Thanks to his sister, he got to see Grandpa.

questions.why: 要不是她，我今年就看不到爺爺了: 要不是 names what really happened (his sister taught Grandpa), and the result after it did not happen: he did see Grandpa, on the phone. Reading 要不是 as 不是 gives the first choice; taking the result as fact gives the second.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳過年去了哪裡？
lines.simplified: 你过年去了哪里？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ guònián qù le nǎlǐ?
lines.english: Where did you go for New Year?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 去台東舅舅家拜年。舅舅家裡有老人要照顧，過年從來不出遠門，所以每年都是我們去看他。
lines.simplified: 去台东舅舅家拜年。舅舅家里有老人要照顾，过年从来不出远门，所以每年都是我们去看他。
lines.pinyin: Qù Táidōng jiùjiu jiā bàinián. Jiùjiu jiā lǐ yǒu lǎorén yào zhàogù, guònián cónglái bù chū yuǎnmén, suǒyǐ měi nián dōu shì wǒmen qù kàn tā.
lines.english: To my uncle's in Taitung for a New Year visit. My uncle has an elderly relative at home to look after, so he never travels far over New Year, so every year we go to see him.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 台東那麼遠，你們怎麼去的？
lines.simplified: 台东那么远，你们怎么去的？
lines.pinyin: Táidōng nàme yuǎn, nǐmen zěnme qù de?
lines.english: Taitung is so far. How did you get there?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 坐火車。票很難買，要不是舅媽每天在網路上幫我們找，我們就得開八個小時的車了。
lines.simplified: 坐火车。票很难买，要不是舅妈每天在网路上帮我们找，我们就得开八个小时的车了。
lines.pinyin: Zuò huǒchē. Piào hěn nán mǎi, yàobúshì jiùmā měi tiān zài wǎnglù shàng bāng wǒmen zhǎo, wǒmen jiù děi kāi bā ge xiǎoshí de chē le.
lines.english: By train. Tickets were hard to get: if my aunt hadn't looked online for us every day, we'd have had to drive for eight hours.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳舅媽真好！
lines.simplified: 你舅妈真好！
lines.pinyin: Nǐ jiùmā zhēn hǎo!
lines.english: Your aunt is so kind!

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 是啊，我們到的時候，她正在煮米粉湯。
lines.simplified: 是啊，我们到的时候，她正在煮米粉汤。
lines.pinyin: Shì a, wǒmen dào de shíhòu, tā zhèngzài zhǔ mǐfěn tāng.
lines.english: Yes, and she was making rice-noodle soup when we arrived.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 為什麼每年都是她們去台東？
prompt.simplified: 为什么每年都是她们去台东？
prompt.pinyin: Wèishénme měi nián dōu shì tāmen qù Táidōng?
prompt.english: Why do they go to Taitung every year?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Jiùmā hěn huì zhǔ mǐfěn tāng.
choices.english: Her aunt makes good rice-noodle soup.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 舅舅不想開八小時的車
choices.simplified: 舅舅不想开八小时的车
choices.pinyin: Jiùjiu bù xiǎng kāi bā xiǎoshí de chē.
choices.english: Her uncle doesn't want to drive for eight hours.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Jiùjiu děi zài jiā zhàogù lǎorén.
choices.english: Her uncle needs to stay home to look after an elderly relative.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Huǒchē piào hěn róngyì mǎi dào.
choices.english: Train tickets are easy to get.

questions.why: He has an elderly relative to look after, so he never travels far over New Year (從來不出遠門) and they go to see him. The eight-hour drive is what her own family would have faced, and the hard-to-get tickets belong to this trip only.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 從對話可以知道什麼？
prompt.simplified: 从对话可以知道什么？
prompt.pinyin: Cóng duìhuà kěyǐ zhīdào shénme?
prompt.english: What can we learn from the conversation?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 因為舅媽，她們才買到票
choices.simplified: 因为舅妈，她们才买到票
choices.pinyin: Yīnwèi jiùmā, tāmen cái mǎi dào piào.
choices.english: Thanks to the aunt, they got tickets.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她們開了八個小時的車
choices.simplified: 她们开了八个小时的车
choices.pinyin: Tāmen kāi le bā ge xiǎoshí de chē.
choices.english: They drove for eight hours.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Jiùjiu bāng tāmen mǎi dào le piào.
choices.english: The uncle got the tickets for them.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Mǐfěn tāng shì tāmen zhǔ de.
choices.english: They made the rice-noodle soup.

questions.why: 要不是舅媽每天在網路上幫我們找，我們就得開八個小時的車了: the aunt searched every day and they went by train, so the eight-hour drive did not happen. It was the aunt, not the uncle, who looked, and the aunt was already making the soup when they arrived.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段留言，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段留言，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn liúyán, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a voice message, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 喂，是媽媽。我打了兩次電話都找不到你，只好留言。
lines.simplified: 喂，是妈妈。我打了两次电话都找不到你，只好留言。
lines.pinyin: Wéi, shì māma. Wǒ dǎ le liǎng cì diànhuà dōu zhǎo bú dào nǐ, zhǐhǎo liúyán.
lines.english: Hello, it's Mom. I tried calling twice and couldn't reach you, so I'm leaving a message.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 除夕那天，當火車到台南的時候，你就打電話給爸爸，他會開車到車站帶你回家。你舅舅跟舅媽坐下一班車，你在車站等他們，大家再一起走。
lines.simplified: 除夕那天，当火车到台南的时候，你就打电话给爸爸，他会开车到车站带你回家。你舅舅跟舅妈坐下一班车，你在车站等他们，大家再一起走。
lines.pinyin: Chúxī nà tiān, dāng huǒchē dào Táinán de shíhòu, nǐ jiù dǎ diànhuà gěi bàba, tā huì kāichē dào chēzhàn dài nǐ huíjiā. Nǐ jiùjiu gēn jiùmā zuò xià yì bān chē, nǐ zài chēzhàn děng tāmen, dàjiā zài yìqǐ zǒu.
lines.english: On New Year's Eve, when the train gets to Tainan, call Dad and he'll drive to the station to take you home. Your uncle and aunt are on the next train: wait for them at the station, and then you can all leave together.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 爸爸昨天把橘子跟外套寄到學校了。
lines.simplified: 爸爸昨天把橘子跟外套寄到学校了。
lines.pinyin: Bàba zuótiān bǎ júzi gēn wàitào jì dào xuéxiào le.
lines.english: Dad mailed the tangerines and the jacket to your school yesterday.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 還有，奶奶做了很多蘿蔔糕跟年糕，說吃了年糕會年年高升。蘿蔔糕跟年糕不好寄，過完年回學校時，你再帶一些走，分給你的室友吃。
lines.simplified: 还有，奶奶做了很多萝卜糕跟年糕，说吃了年糕会年年高升。萝卜糕跟年糕不好寄，过完年回学校时，你再带一些走，分给你的室友吃。
lines.pinyin: Háiyǒu, nǎinai zuò le hěn duō luóbogāo gēn niángāo, shuō chī le niángāo huì niánnián gāoshēng. Luóbogāo gēn niángāo bù hǎo jì, guò wán nián huí xuéxiào shí, nǐ zài dài yìxiē zǒu, fēn gěi nǐ de shìyǒu chī.
lines.english: And Grandma has made lots of radish cake and New Year cake; she says eating New Year cake helps you rise higher every year. The cakes are hard to mail, so when you go back to school after New Year, take some with you and share them with your roommates.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 聽留言的人到了台南，要先做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 听留言的人到了台南，要先做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Tīng liúyán de rén dào le Táinán, yào xiān zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What should the person hearing the message do first on reaching Tainan?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Dǎ diànhuà gěi māma.
choices.english: Call his mother.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zìjǐ zuò chē huíjiā.
choices.english: Take a bus home by himself.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Dǎ diànhuà gàosu bàba dào le.
choices.english: Call his father to say he has arrived.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zhǎo zài chēzhàn děng tā de jiùjiu.
choices.english: Find the uncle who is waiting for him at the station.

questions.why: 當火車到台南的時候，你就打電話給爸爸: as soon as the train arrives he should call his father, who will then drive to the station. It is he who waits for his uncle and aunt, who come on the next train, not the other way round; his mother only left the message.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 要帶到學校的東西，媽媽怎麼安排？
prompt.simplified: 要带到学校的东西，妈妈怎么安排？
prompt.pinyin: Yào dài dào xuéxiào de dōngxi, māma zěnme ānpái?
prompt.english: How has his mother arranged the things that are to go to school?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 年糕自己帶，橘子已經寄了
choices.simplified: 年糕自己带，橘子已经寄了
choices.pinyin: Niángāo zìjǐ dài, júzi yǐjīng jì le.
choices.english: He takes the cakes himself; the tangerines are already mailed.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 年糕跟橘子都請爸爸寄
choices.simplified: 年糕跟橘子都请爸爸寄
choices.pinyin: Niángāo gēn júzi dōu qǐng bàba jì.
choices.english: Dad is to mail both the cakes and the tangerines.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 橘子自己帶，年糕請爸爸寄
choices.simplified: 橘子自己带，年糕请爸爸寄
choices.pinyin: Júzi zìjǐ dài, niángāo qǐng bàba jì.
choices.english: He takes the tangerines himself; Dad mails the cakes.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 年糕自己帶，外套過完年再寄
choices.simplified: 年糕自己带，外套过完年再寄
choices.pinyin: Niángāo zìjǐ dài, wàitào guò wán nián zài jì.
choices.english: He takes the cakes himself; the jacket is mailed after New Year.

questions.why: Dad mailed the tangerines and the jacket yesterday, but the cakes are hard to mail, so he is to take some with him (帶一些走) when he goes back to school. The other choices swap what is mailed and what he carries, or put the jacket after New Year.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn huà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a short talk, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 歡迎大家來廟裡拜拜。今天是除夕，人特別多，請大家從左邊的門進來，不要擠。
lines.simplified: 欢迎大家来庙里拜拜。今天是除夕，人特别多，请大家从左边的门进来，不要挤。
lines.pinyin: Huānyíng dàjiā lái miào lǐ bàibài. Jīntiān shì chúxī, rén tèbié duō, qǐng dàjiā cóng zuǒbiān de mén jìnlái, búyào jǐ.
lines.english: Welcome to the temple. It's New Year's Eve and very crowded today, so please come in through the door on the left and don't push.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 當您拜完以後，就請從右邊的門離開，讓後面的人可以進來。
lines.simplified: 当您拜完以后，就请从右边的门离开，让后面的人可以进来。
lines.pinyin: Dāng nín bài wán yǐhòu, jiù qǐng cóng yòubiān de mén líkāi, ràng hòumiàn de rén kěyǐ jìnlái.
lines.english: When you have finished praying, please leave by the door on the right, so the people behind you can come in.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 廟裡準備了一些發糕，希望大家新的一年都能發財。一個人拿一塊就好，請不要拿走太多，讓每個人都拿得到。
lines.simplified: 庙里准备了一些发糕，希望大家新的一年都能发财。一个人拿一块就好，请不要拿走太多，让每个人都拿得到。
lines.pinyin: Miào lǐ zhǔnbèi le yìxiē fāgāo, xīwàng dàjiā xīn de yì nián dōu néng fācái. Yí ge rén ná yí kuài jiù hǎo, qǐng búyào ná zǒu tài duō, ràng měi ge rén dōu ná de dào.
lines.english: The temple has prepared some sponge cakes, wishing you all wealth in the new year. One piece each is enough: please don't take too many, so that everyone gets one.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 還有，晚上十一點以後，廟前面會放鞭炮，有小孩的朋友請小心，別讓孩子嚇到了。
lines.simplified: 还有，晚上十一点以后，庙前面会放鞭炮，有小孩的朋友请小心，别让孩子吓到了。
lines.pinyin: Háiyǒu, wǎnshàng shíyī diǎn yǐhòu, miào qiánmiàn huì fàng biānpào, yǒu xiǎohái de péngyǒu qǐng xiǎoxīn, bié ràng háizi xià dào le.
lines.english: Also, after eleven tonight there will be firecrackers in front of the temple. If you have children with you, please take care they don't get a fright.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 拜完以後，大家應該怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 拜完以后，大家应该怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Bài wán yǐhòu, dàjiā yīnggāi zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What should people do after praying?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Dào miào qiánmiàn fàng biānpào.
choices.english: Set off firecrackers in front of the temple.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zǒu yòushǒubiān de mén chūqù.
choices.english: Leave through the other door.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Cóng jìnlái de mén chūqù.
choices.english: Leave through the entrance.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zài ménkǒu děng hòumiàn de rén.
choices.english: Wait at the door for the people behind.

questions.why: 當您拜完以後，就請從右邊的門離開: once they have prayed, people should leave by the right-hand door so others can come in. The firecrackers are the temple’s, after eleven, and the people behind are let in, not waited for.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 一位爸爸帶兩個孩子來拜拜，照廟裡說的，他們可以怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 一位爸爸带两个孩子来拜拜，照庙里说的，他们可以怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Yí wèi bàba dài liǎng ge háizi lái bàibài, zhào miào lǐ shuō de, tāmen kěyǐ zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: A father brings his two children to the temple. According to the announcement, what may they do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yì jiā rén ná yí kuài fāgāo.
choices.english: The family takes one sponge cake.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Duō ná jǐ kuài gěi jiārén chī.
choices.english: Take a few extra for the rest of the family.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Sān ge rén ná sān kuài fāgāo.
choices.english: The three of them take three sponge cakes.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Ràng háizi qù miào qián fàng biānpào.
choices.english: Let the children set off firecrackers in front of the temple.

questions.why: 一個人拿一塊就好，請不要拿走太多: one piece per person, so a father with two children may take three, but no extra. The firecrackers are the temple’s, and families with children are asked to keep them safe from the noise.

text.traditional:
社區通知
一、垃圾：除夕到春節第三天，垃圾車不來，垃圾請先留在家裡。去年春節有人把垃圾放在大門外面，讓狗給弄得滿地都是。
二、鞭炮：除夕晚上六點到十一點可以放。地點在停車場旁邊的草地，請不要在大門前放。
三、春聯：請貼在自己家的門上，不要貼在大門上。
四、寄來的東西：除夕下午兩點前，管理人員會幫大家收。兩點後寄到的，請到一樓的桌上拿。
社區管理中心

text.pinyin:
Shèqū tōngzhī
Yī, lèsè: chúxī dào chūnjié dì sān tiān, lèsè chē bù lái, lèsè qǐng xiān liú zài jiā lǐ. Qùnián chūnjié yǒu rén bǎ lèsè fàng zài dàmén wàimiàn, ràng gǒu gěi nòng de mǎn dì dōu shì.
Èr, biānpào: chúxī wǎnshàng liù diǎn dào shíyī diǎn kěyǐ fàng. Dìdiǎn zài tíngchēchǎng pángbiān de cǎodì, qǐng búyào zài dàmén qián fàng.
Sān, chūnlián: qǐng tiē zài zìjǐ jiā de mén shàng, búyào tiē zài dàmén shàng.
Sì, jì lái de dōngxi: chúxī xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn qián, guǎnlǐ rényuán huì bāng dàjiā shōu. Liǎng diǎn hòu jì dào de, qǐng dào yī lóu de zhuō shàng ná.
Shèqū guǎnlǐ zhōngxīn
text.english:
Community notice for the Spring Festival
1. Garbage: from New Year's Eve to the third day of the Spring Festival the garbage truck does not come; please keep your garbage at home. Last Spring Festival someone left garbage outside the main gate and dogs scattered it everywhere.
2. Firecrackers: from 6 p.m. to 11 p.m. on New Year’s Eve. Use the lawn beside the parking lot and keep the main gate clear.
3. Spring couplets: please put them on your own door, not on the main gate.
4. Parcels: staff will take in parcels until 2 p.m. on New Year's Eve. Parcels delivered after two will be on the table on the ground floor.
Community management office

我先回家過年了，二月一號晚上回來。冰箱裡有我媽媽做的水餃，妳想吃就自己煮，不用客氣。

passage.traditional: 寒假我在老店打工。春節前，客人常買年糕、發糕、蘿蔔糕等等。除夕那天，我們得在中午前{1}最後幾盒蘿蔔糕，訂的客人下午才來拿。老闆對我們有兩個{2}：蘿蔔要用當天買的，米一定要用台灣的。我做過別的工作，可是{3}沒這麼累過。我本來就喜歡這份工作，看到客人笑著拿走年糕，我就{4}喜歡這份工作了。工作完成後，老闆把剩下的蘿蔔糕{5}給大家，每人一盒，一塊錢也沒收。
passage.simplified: 寒假我在老店打工。春节前，客人常买年糕、发糕、萝卜糕等等。除夕那天，我们得在中午前{1}最后几盒萝卜糕，订的客人下午才来拿。老板对我们有两个{2}：萝卜要用当天买的，米一定要用台湾的。我做过别的工作，可是{3}没这么累过。我本来就喜欢这份工作，看到客人笑着拿走年糕，我就{4}喜欢这份工作了。工作完成后，老板把剩下的萝卜糕{5}给大家，每人一盒，一块钱也没收。
passage.pinyin: Hánjià wǒ zài lǎodiàn dǎgōng. Chūnjié qián, kèrén cháng mǎi niángāo, fāgāo, luóbogāo děngděng. Chúxī nà tiān, wǒmen děi zài zhōngwǔ qián zuò wán zuìhòu jǐ hé luóbogāo, dìng de kèrén xiàwǔ cái lái ná. Lǎobǎn duì wǒmen yǒu liǎng ge yāoqiú: luóbo yào yòng dāngtiān mǎi de, mǐ yídìng yào yòng Táiwān de. Wǒ zuò guo bié de gōngzuò, kěshì cónglái méi zhème lèi guo. Wǒ běnlái jiù xǐhuān zhè fèn gōngzuò, kàndào kèrén xiàozhe ná zǒu niángāo, wǒ jiù gèngjiā xǐhuān zhè fèn gōngzuò le. Gōngzuò wánchéng hòu, lǎobǎn bǎ shèngxià de luóbogāo fēn gěi dàjiā, měi rén yì hé, yí kuài qián yě méi shōu.
passage.english: I worked part-time at a long-established shop over winter break. Before the Spring Festival, customers often bought New Year rice cakes, sponge cakes, radish cakes and so on. On New Year's Eve, we had to finish making the last few boxes of radish cake before noon: the customers who had ordered them would come for them in the afternoon. The boss had two requirements for us: the radishes had to be bought that day, and we had to use Taiwanese rice. I'd had other jobs, but I'd never been that tired. I already liked the work, and seeing customers smile as they took their rice cakes away made me like it even more. When the work was done, the boss shared out the leftover radish cakes, one box per person, without taking a cent.

passage.traditional: 今年春節我到室友的舅舅家過年。第一次見面，她的舅舅、舅媽就對我很{1}，像對自己的孩子一樣。除夕晚上，大家先吃年夜飯，{2}一起到門口放鞭炮。鞭炮一響，我嚇了一跳。{3}舅媽拉住我，我早就跑回房間了。第二天，室友帶我去鄰居家{4}。我們一進門就說「新年快樂」。回學校前，我寫了卡片，{5}舅舅一家讓我在花蓮過了一個溫暖的春節。
passage.simplified: 今年春节我到室友的舅舅家过年。第一次见面，她的舅舅、舅妈就对我很{1}，像对自己的孩子一样。除夕晚上，大家先吃年夜饭，{2}一起到门口放鞭炮。鞭炮一响，我吓了一跳。{3}舅妈拉住我，我早就跑回房间了。第二天，室友带我去邻居家{4}。我们一进门就说「新年快乐」。回学校前，我写了卡片，{5}舅舅一家让我在花莲过了一个温暖的春节。
passage.pinyin: Jīnnián chūnjié wǒ dào shìyǒu de jiùjiu jiā guònián. Dì yī cì jiànmiàn, tā de jiùjiu, jiùmā jiù duì wǒ hěn qīnqiè, xiàng duì zìjǐ de háizi yíyàng. Chúxī wǎnshàng, dàjiā xiān chī niányèfàn, jiēzhe yìqǐ dào ménkǒu fàng biānpào. Biānpào yì xiǎng, wǒ xià le yí tiào. Yàobúshì jiùmā lā zhù wǒ, wǒ zǎo jiù pǎo huí fángjiān le. Dì èr tiān, shìyǒu dài wǒ qù línjū jiā bàinián. Wǒmen yí jìn mén jiù shuō “xīnnián kuàilè”. Huí xuéxiào qián, wǒ xiě le kǎpiàn, gǎnxiè jiùjiu yì jiā ràng wǒ zài Huālián guò le yí ge wēnnuǎn de chūnjié.
passage.english: I spent this Spring Festival at my roommate's uncle's home. Her uncle and aunt were warm to me right from our first meeting, treating me like their own child. On New Year's Eve, everyone had dinner first and then went out to the door together to set off firecrackers. I jumped when they went off. If her aunt hadn't held on to me, I would have run back to my room right then. The next day my roommate took me to pay New Year visits to the neighbours. We said “Happy New Year” as soon as we stepped inside. Before going back to school, I wrote a card thanking her uncle's family for making my Spring Festival in Hualien so warm.

奶奶常說，從前過日子很辛苦，平日很少吃肉。只有慶祝新年的時候，才吃得到雞、鴨、魚、肉。除夕一定要有魚，才會年年有餘。除夕前幾天，我們家就開始自己做年糕、發糕、蘿蔔糕等等。我們家只有三口人，爺爺用一節竹子就做得出三雙筷子，奶奶在廚房裡忙，火從早燒到晚。到了除夕晚上，一家人聚在一起吃年夜飯，大家一聽見外面的鞭炮響，就知道新的一年要來了。
現在準備年菜方便多了，市場有各式各樣的年菜，餐廳也能訂年夜飯。奶奶還記得從前家裡總是很亮，相當熱鬧，不過她也說，年菜是自己做的還是買的，都無所謂，只要一家人平平安安地在一起，這樣過年就最好了。
text.simplified:
奶奶常说，从前过日子很辛苦，平日很少吃肉。只有庆祝新年的时候，才吃得到鸡、鸭、鱼、肉。除夕一定要有鱼，才会年年有余。除夕前几天，我们家就开始自己做年糕、发糕、萝卜糕等等。我们家只有三口人，爷爷用一节竹子就做得出三双筷子，奶奶在厨房里忙，火从早烧到晚。到了除夕晚上，一家人聚在一起吃年夜饭，大家一听见外面的鞭炮响，就知道新的一年要来了。
现在准备年菜方便多了，市场有各式各样的年菜，餐厅也能订年夜饭。奶奶还记得从前家里总是很亮，相当热闹，不过她也说，年菜是自己做的还是买的，都无所谓，只要一家人平平安安地在一起，这样过年就最好了。
text.pinyin:
Nǎinai cháng shuō, cóngqián guòrìzi hěn xīnkǔ, píngrì hěn shǎo chī ròu. Zhǐyǒu qìngzhù xīnnián de shíhòu, cái chī de dào jī, yā, yú, ròu. Chúxī yídìng yào yǒu yú, cái huì niánnián yǒuyú. Chúxī qián jǐ tiān, wǒmen jiā jiù kāishǐ zìjǐ zuò niángāo, fāgāo, luóbogāo děngděng. Wǒmen jiā zhǐ yǒu sān kǒu rén, yéye yòng yì jié zhúzi jiù zuò de chū sān shuāng kuàizi, nǎinai zài chúfáng lǐ máng, huǒ cóng zǎo shāo dào wǎn. Dào le chúxī wǎnshàng, yì jiā rén jù zài yìqǐ chī niányèfàn, dàjiā yì tīngjiàn wàimiàn de biānpào xiǎng, jiù zhīdào xīn de yì nián yào lái le.
Xiànzài zhǔnbèi niáncài fāngbiàn duō le, shìchǎng yǒu gèshìgèyàng de niáncài, cāntīng yě néng dìng niányèfàn. Nǎinai hái jìde cóngqián jiā lǐ zǒngshì hěn liàng, xiāngdāng rènào, bùguò tā yě shuō, niáncài shì zìjǐ zuò de háishì mǎi de, dōu wúsuǒwèi, zhǐyào yì jiā rén píngpíng ān'ān de zài yìqǐ, zhèyàng guònián jiù zuì hǎo le.
text.english:
Grandma often says life was hard in the old days and they rarely ate meat on ordinary days. Only when celebrating New Year could they have chicken, duck, fish or meat. On New Year's Eve there had to be fish, so that there would be plenty (餘, which sounds like 魚) year after year. In the days before New Year's Eve our family made rice cakes, sponge cakes, radish cakes and so on. There were only three people in the family. Grandpa could make three pairs of chopsticks from one section of bamboo, and Grandma kept the kitchen fire going from morning to night. On New Year's Eve the family gathered for dinner, and as soon as they heard the firecrackers outside, they knew the new year was coming.
Getting the New Year food ready is much easier now. The market has all kinds of festive dishes, and you can reserve dinner at a restaurant. Grandma still remembers how bright and lively their home used to be. She says a good New Year is when the family is together and safe, whether they cook or buy the food.

text.traditional:
我跟媽媽還有爺爺、奶奶住在一起，樓下住著一位老太太。她先生前年就不在了，孩子都在國外工作，過年也回不來。今年除夕下午，媽媽說她一個人過年太可憐了，要我去請她上來吃年夜飯。老太太一開始說不要，怕麻煩我們，我說我們煮了很多，她才答應。
晚上六點，老太太出現在我家門口，手上拿著她自己做的年糕、發糕等等，說是要感謝我們。媽媽也送了她一包橘子，說橘子有「大吉大利」的意思。吃飯的時候，她說了很多從前過年的事，大家都聽得很開心。
吃完飯，我送她下樓。她說，這是她這幾年第一次覺得過年這麼溫暖，心裡相當感動。離開她家時，我想到桌上還剩下很多菜。讓她開心的，應該是有人陪她吃飯吧。
text.simplified:
我跟妈妈还有爷爷、奶奶住在一起，楼下住着一位老太太。她先生前年就不在了，孩子都在国外工作，过年也回不来。今年除夕下午，妈妈说她一个人过年太可怜了，要我去请她上来吃年夜饭。老太太一开始说不要，怕麻烦我们，我说我们煮了很多，她才答应。
晚上六点，老太太出现在我家门口，手上拿着她自己做的年糕、发糕等等，说是要感谢我们。妈妈也送了她一包橘子，说橘子有「大吉大利」的意思。吃饭的时候，她说了很多从前过年的事，大家都听得很开心。
吃完饭，我送她下楼。她说，这是她这几年第一次觉得过年这么温暖，心里相当感动。离开她家时，我想到桌上还剩下很多菜。让她开心的，应该是有人陪她吃饭吧。
text.pinyin:
Wǒ gēn māma háiyǒu yéye, nǎinai zhù zài yìqǐ, lóuxià zhùzhe yí wèi lǎotàitai. Tā xiānshēng qiánnián jiù bú zài le, háizi dōu zài guówài gōngzuò, guònián yě huí bù lái. Jīnnián chúxī xiàwǔ, māma shuō tā yí ge rén guònián tài kělián le, yào wǒ qù qǐng tā shànglái chī niányèfàn. Lǎotàitai yìkāishǐ shuō búyào, pà máfan wǒmen, wǒ shuō wǒmen zhǔ le hěn duō, tā cái dāyìng.
Wǎnshàng liù diǎn, lǎotàitai chūxiàn zài wǒ jiā ménkǒu, shǒu shàng názhe tā zìjǐ zuò de niángāo, fāgāo děngděng, shuō shì yào gǎnxiè wǒmen. Māma yě sòng le tā yì bāo júzi, shuō júzi yǒu “dàjídàlì” de yìsi. Chī fàn de shíhòu, tā shuō le hěn duō cóngqián guònián de shì, dàjiā dōu tīng de hěn kāixīn.
Chī wán fàn, wǒ sòng tā xià lóu. Tā shuō, zhè shì tā zhè jǐ nián dì yī cì juéde guònián zhème wēnnuǎn, xīnli xiāngdāng gǎndòng. Líkāi tā jiā shí, wǒ xiǎngdào zhuō shàng hái shèngxià hěn duō cài. Ràng tā kāixīn de, yīnggāi shì yǒu rén péi tā chī fàn ba.
text.english:
I live with my mother and grandparents. An older woman lives downstairs from us. Her husband passed away the year before last, and her children all work abroad and can't come back even for New Year. This New Year's Eve afternoon my mother said it was too sad for her to spend New Year alone and asked me to invite her up for dinner. At first the old lady said no, not wanting to trouble us; only when I said we had cooked plenty did she agree.
At six o'clock she appeared at our door with New Year cakes, sponge cakes and other things she had made herself, to thank us. My mother gave her a bag of tangerines, saying tangerines mean 'great luck'. At dinner she told us many stories about New Year in the old days, and we all loved listening.
After dinner I walked her downstairs. She said it was the first time in years that New Year had felt so warm, and that she was quite moved. As I left her apartment, I remembered how much food was still on the table. It must have been having people to eat with that made her happy.

text.traditional: 今年寒假，我在一家貿易公司當經理的助理。公司的員工不多，工作相當多。剛開始，我什麼都不會，連傳真機都不會用，只好請同事說明機器的功能，有不懂的地方也常向他們問問題。經理看我那麼緊張，就說：「誰第一天上班就什麼都會呢？慢慢來。」從那天起，我每天都早半個小時到公司，把同事教我的做法都練習一次。春節前那個星期，公司特別忙，大家天天加班。經理說我是學生，不用加班，可是我還是留在公司幫忙。過年以前，經理送了我一盒年糕，說他對我很滿意，明年寒假歡迎再來。後來我聽別的同事說，經理以前也是從助理開始做的，難怪他那麼了解剛來的人。
text.simplified: 今年寒假，我在一家贸易公司当经理的助理。公司的员工不多，工作相当多。刚开始，我什么都不会，连传真机都不会用，只好请同事说明机器的功能，有不懂的地方也常向他们问问题。经理看我那么紧张，就说：「谁第一天上班就什么都会呢？慢慢来。」从那天起，我每天都早半个小时到公司，把同事教我的做法都练习一次。春节前那个星期，公司特别忙，大家天天加班。经理说我是学生，不用加班，可是我还是留在公司帮忙。过年以前，经理送了我一盒年糕，说他对我很满意，明年寒假欢迎再来。后来我听别的同事说，经理以前也是从助理开始做的，难怪他那么了解刚来的人。
text.pinyin: Jīnnián hánjià, wǒ zài yì jiā màoyì gōngsī dāng jīnglǐ de zhùlǐ. Gōngsī de yuángōng bù duō, gōngzuò xiāngdāng duō. Gāng kāishǐ, wǒ shénme dōu bú huì, lián chuánzhēnjī dōu bú huì yòng, zhǐhǎo qǐng tóngshì shuōmíng jīqì de gōngnéng, yǒu bù dǒng de dìfāng yě cháng xiàng tāmen wèn wèntí. Jīnglǐ kàn wǒ nàme jǐnzhāng, jiù shuō: “Shéi dì yī tiān shàngbān jiù shénme dōu huì ne? Mànmàn lái.” Cóng nà tiān qǐ, wǒ měi tiān dōu zǎo bàn ge xiǎoshí dào gōngsī, bǎ tóngshì jiāo wǒ de zuòfǎ dōu liànxí yí cì. Chūnjié qián nà ge xīngqí, gōngsī tèbié máng, dàjiā tiāntiān jiābān. Jīnglǐ shuō wǒ shì xuéshēng, búyòng jiābān, kěshì wǒ háishì liú zài gōngsī bāngmáng. Guònián yǐqián, jīnglǐ sòng le wǒ yì hé niángāo, shuō tā duì wǒ hěn mǎnyì, míngnián hánjià huānyíng zài lái. Hòulái wǒ tīng bié de tóngshì shuō, jīnglǐ yǐqián yě shì cóng zhùlǐ kāishǐ zuò de, nánguài tā nàme liǎojiě gāng lái de rén.
text.english: This winter break I worked as a manager's assistant at a trading company. There are few employees and a lot of work. At first I couldn't do anything, not even use the fax machine, so I asked my colleagues to explain how the machine worked, and whenever there was something I didn't understand I asked them too. Seeing how nervous I was, the manager said, 'Who can do everything on their first day? Take your time.' From that day on I got to the office half an hour early every day and practised everything my colleagues had shown me once more. The week before the Spring Festival the company was extremely busy and everyone worked overtime every day. The manager said I was a student and didn't need to, but I stayed on to help anyway. Before New Year he gave me a box of New Year cake, said he was pleased with me, and told me I was welcome back next winter. Later another colleague told me the manager had started as an assistant himself: no wonder he understands newcomers so well.

text.traditional:
春節前，社區安排我們把年菜送給附近的老人。有的公寓沒有電梯，我連走上三樓都累得不得了。想到除夕那天還要搬好幾盒年糕跟蘿蔔糕，我開始擔心自己的體力。
我去健身房找教練。他說，一開始不要搬重的東西，先每天練習走樓梯。剛開始手上不用拿東西，等體力好一點，再拿著一兩盒東西練習。他也叫我晚上別開夜車，白天才有精神。
練習越多，走起來越輕鬆。到了除夕，我不但把年菜送到了，還有體力替樓上的老人搬米。隔壁的鄰居看見了，說明年也想一起幫忙。
text.simplified:
春节前，社区安排我们把年菜送给附近的老人。有的公寓没有电梯，我连走上三楼都累得不得了。想到除夕那天还要搬好几盒年糕跟萝卜糕，我开始担心自己的体力。
我去健身房找教练。他说，一开始不要搬重的东西，先每天练习走楼梯。刚开始手上不用拿东西，等体力好一点，再拿着一两盒东西练习。他也叫我晚上别开夜车，白天才有精神。
练习越多，走起来越轻松。到了除夕，我不但把年菜送到了，还有体力替楼上的老人搬米。隔壁的邻居看见了，说明年也想一起帮忙。
text.pinyin:
Chūnjié qián, shèqū ānpái wǒmen bǎ niáncài sòng gěi fùjìn de lǎorén. Yǒu de gōngyù méiyǒu diàntī, wǒ lián zǒu shàng sān lóu dōu lèi de bùdéliǎo. Xiǎngdào chúxī nà tiān hái yào bān hǎo jǐ hé niángāo gēn luóbogāo, wǒ kāishǐ dānxīn zìjǐ de tǐlì.
Wǒ qù jiànshēnfáng zhǎo jiàoliàn. Tā shuō, yìkāishǐ búyào bān zhòng de dōngxi, xiān měi tiān liànxí zǒu lóutī. Gāng kāishǐ shǒu shàng búyòng ná dōngxi, děng tǐlì hǎo yìdiǎn, zài názhe yì liǎng hé dōngxi liànxí. Tā yě jiào wǒ wǎnshàng bié kāi yèchē, báitiān cái yǒu jīngshén.
Liànxí yuè duō, zǒu qǐlái yuè qīngsōng. Dào le chúxī, wǒ búdàn bǎ niáncài sòng dào le, hái yǒu tǐlì tì lóu shàng de lǎorén bān mǐ. Gébì de línjū kànjiàn le, shuō míngnián yě xiǎng yìqǐ bāngmáng.
text.english:
Before the Spring Festival, the community arranged for us to deliver New Year's food to older people nearby. Some apartment buildings had no elevator, and even walking up to the third floor wore me out. When I thought about carrying several boxes of rice cake and radish cake on New Year's Eve, I worried about my stamina.
I went to the gym to see a coach. He said I should practise walking up stairs every day instead of starting with something heavy. I should start empty-handed and practise carrying a box or two once my stamina improved. He also reminded me to go to bed on time so I wouldn't be tired during the day.
The more I practised, the easier it got. On New Year's Eve I delivered the food and still had the energy to carry rice for someone upstairs. The next-door neighbour saw me and said they'd like to help next year.
